_instructions: Fill one file per publisher. Fields marked [REQUIRED] must be completed before the source is considered 'established'. Fields marked [RECOMMENDED] are high-value but can be deferred. Fields marked [EVIDENCE-REQUIRED] must include a citation in the 'researchLog' section.

identity.name: Nikkei Asia
identity.description: The English-language arm of Nikkei Inc., Japan's largest financial media group. Covers business, markets, politics, and technology across Asia with a particular depth in East Asian supply chains, semiconductors, and corporate strategy.

editorialProfile.knownPerspective: Japanese business newspaper with institutional depth in Asian corporate and economic reporting. Tends to frame events through trade, investment, and market impact.
knownWeaknesses: Limited Middle East and Africa coverage
Business-first framing may underweight humanitarian angles

reliability.notes: No MBFC or NewsGuard rating found for Nikkei Asia specifically. Parent company Nikkei Inc. is considered Japan's most authoritative financial publisher.

systemMapping._comment: These fields map directly to the current FeedSource schema and RawArticle propagation.

evidenceSources.source: Self-assessment based on editorial sampling (30 articles) + Ad Fontes cross-reference

researchLog.researchNotes: Nikkei Asia is the international English edition of Nikkei Inc. It was relaunched in its current form in 2013, though the parent company dates to 1876. Coverage leans heavily toward economic and corporate Asia. The FT acquisition in 2015 gives it an unusual dual-hemisphere presence.
